text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: —Ah!!!! They're here!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-chaaaan!!"
"Good luck in the Osaka Hai!" "We're rooting for ya!"
"Show us an amazing run---!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
thank you for your support!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan!
Congratulations on Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
I wrote a certificate too.
So I can be the Horse of the Year this year too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Hehe, aren't you an impatient one?
Still, thank you! I'll gladly accept it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
Yay...! Um, um!
I love you so much, Ai-chan!
Please don't lose...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Of course!
Please come to the racetrack to watch.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll show you what it looks like when I win!
By now, expectations for Almond Eye had firmly set in, and many people seemed almost certain of her victory.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Overwhelming strength is something that captivates people in every era, doesn't it!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it really is—... Wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahahahaa!
Behold my beauty, splendid enough to warrant a double take!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san!

T.M. Opera O... She, too, is one of the great Umamusume
who achieved 7 turf G1 victories.
And what makes her so astonishing is—

Consecutive Gâ  wins, undefeated for the entire year.
Truly reigning over an era with the sheer presence
befitting the title "Overlord of the Century's End."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My soul cried out!
To behold the glorious opera of Hanshin Racecourse... it said.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Oh, so they're having that kind of event today, too.
choice_data_list: It's probably a metaphor. What she means is—
It's probably a metaphor. What she means is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Entertain me
with your rivalry!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: In other words, exactly that. —Ciao, fair Carmen!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Me, as Carmen?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, in the opera Carmen,
if I remember correctly, the ending is...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "...You've been remarkably in sync with Opera O-san's intentions for a while now, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Then, I wonder if you can tell
what I want to say right now?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: *staaaaaaaare...*

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Geez!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Correct!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah...!!
Almond Eyyyye!!

—The gathered spectators are all
completely captivated by the brilliant star.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
She is strong—incredibly strong.
Everyone expects her to win today as well—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—And diving into the fray is Kiseki!
Fearlessly talking back...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Time for revengeee!
Don't think I'm the same girl as before, Ai!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! No, that's where you're supposed to flinch...
Ugh, scrap this plot twist, I guess!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There's no problem at all, though!
I've already thought up dozens of scenarios
where I come out on top!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Each and every one of them is a truly thrilling story.
—And it's all thanks to your strength!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, Ai-chan!
I'll defeat you—and kick off Part Two of this miracle!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, waaaait!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Let Boo in tooo!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I? I was super excited
to run with you today, Ai!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
—Because I respect Ai!
That's why I want to win!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
We'll win... and show the whole world
just how strong best friends can be!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Blast.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad Kiseki-chan and everyone else...
are throwing their heartfelt passion right at me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still... I only have one desire.
—To transcend everything and win!!
